literal_cells: 2450 / EP-1039 — Polynomial lemniscate inradius: the explicit uniform positive c/n question for all monic degree-n polynomials with roots in the closed unit disk, and sharp worst-case order 1/n.

Existing public proofs, not a new project publication. Nat Sothanaphan, A streamlined proof of the 1/n inradius bound for polynomial lemniscates (PDF dated9May2026; linked in EP1039 post6336 dated8May2026), gives a complete independently checked five-page proof of rho(p)>=log(2)/n, crediting Liam Price and disclosing GPT-5.5 Thinking assistance. Full source: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ik7Nf9Jvo5C4xINBP8G-guGk8-9gNVOm/view . The DOI identifies YuJian Geng and Dong Qiu, From log2 to pi/2: the sharp asymptotic inradius of polynomial lemniscates, arXiv2609.06461v1 (submitted6September2026): Section2, Lemmas2.1-2.2, Proposition2.3 and Corollary2.4 were independently checked in full and prove the stronger universal zero-centered radius2^(1/n)-1>log(2)/n. It is a solution-preprint DOI for this explicit subquestion, not the original-question or a dependency DOI. The broader sharp pi/2 limiting theorem in Sections3-7 was not independently audited here. Price/Kitamura/Sothanaphan/Bloom baseline contributions are credited; Price’s actual Overleaf PDF remains inaccessible. PR https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1309 is a separately verified credited reconstruction with root-centered endpoint, upper witness and maximum-inradius1 proofs. AI assistance disclosed; no exclusive firstness, journal acceptance, current tracker acceptance or Lean/Canto build certification. No new upload or DOI reservation proposed.
